name: Newsprint
pitch: A war story or postmortem told as front-page news, where every slide is a headline and every number is a front-page figure.

illustration.medium: flat vector styled as a front-page newspaper illustration or engraving, on cream newsprint
illustration.line: 2px strokes with a slightly inked, halftone-adjacent feel, hard edges
illustration.shapes: rectangles and columns like a broadsheet layout, no rounded corners
illustration.texture: subtle halftone dot or newsprint grain, never smooth gradients
illustration.palette_use: cream background dominant, near-black ink, one masthead red used only for the headline element
illustration.avoid: gradients, glossy 3D, rounded corners, soft pastel color, modern UI chrome
